identity_rule: Hash exact Git/file bytes with lowercase SHA-256; bind preparation/source revision separately from later implementation/result revision; never embed an unknowable self commit SHA.
blocking: R0-R4 obligation evidence with active assertions
Windows native and Web debug-on/off build outcomes or explicit classified environment blocker
minimal target dependency audit proving no Playground/Debug UI link in core
corroborative: Windows/Web artifact hashes and start instructions
manual physical observations retained as PHYSICAL_PENDING until performed
physical_status: PHYSICAL_PENDING unless actual Windows/Web observation is performed
materialization_requirement: P31 package must be pushed as an immutable reviewer-resolvable commit; P32 must push exact implementation/result/evidence revision before READY_FOR_CONTROL_REVIEW.
authority_boundary: P32 must resolve a typed accepted Document ResourceManifest source. If unavailable at the task anchor, return BLOCKED_AUTHORITY before R2 production mutation.
